Subject: Ostrem Apartments LP - Referral Required

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Ostrem Apartments LP. I've reviewed the information and appreciate having everything we need upfront.

Before I can move forward with a quote, I need to refer this to our senior underwriter due to the five-year incurred losses exceeding $250K. This is above my binding authority.

I'll have an answer for you within 2-3 business days. If the loss history proves challenging for our appetite, you might also consider reaching out to a specialty market or wholesale broker, as they often have more flexibility with higher loss ratios.

I'll be in touch soon!

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
